description: Add a card to a column. The server assigns the human key (OPUS-451) — it is in the reply.

card_id.description: Id to give the card (optional). Pass your own to make a retry safe: adding the same id twice is a no-op instead of a duplicate.

column_id.description: Column to add to (ids come from get_kanban_board).

priority.description: None | Low | Medium | High | Critical (optional, default Medium).

title.description: Card title — what has to be done.

name: create_kanban_card
title: Create task card
